dogecoin.text: Big news for Dogecoin! Z Squared's merger with Coeptis will make it one of the largest publicly traded DOGE mining firms. Potential boost for investor confidence and the crypto's price. Exciting developments ahead!

Bloomberg ETF analysts estimate high chances of approval for certain crypto spot ETFs:
- Litecoin (LTC): 90%
- Solana (SOL): 90%
- XRP: 85%
- Dogecoin (DOGE): 75-80%

Final SEC decision deadlines are between October 2-18.
